response.text: {"name":"Emerald Bend","idea":"The shop is named after a bend in the road and sits beside the emerald Soča, so the page is built around one thick green stroke that turns a corner: the road bend and the river bend as a single mark, with the promise of a same-day fix as the biggest words on the page.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#ffffff"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#eef5f2"},{"role":"text","hex":"#14201c"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#4d5f58"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#0f7b6c"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f4faf7"},{"role":"border","hex":"#c9d8d2"},{"role":"inverse","hex":"#14201c"},{"role":"onInverse","hex":"#f4faf7"},{"role":"band","hex":"#0f7b6c"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#f4faf7"}],"pairing":"bricolage-public-sans","typeCharacter":"Bricolage Grotesque is a sans with odd, slightly rough proportions that feel like a workshop rather than an office; headings set bold, sentence case, tight line height, the h1 at about 9vw across 10 columns, section headings at 3.5vw; Public Sans at 18px regular for running text, 16px for lists and the hours table, with the phone number in Bricolage bold at 6vw.","composition":"Section 1 (hero, white ground, 5 rows): a small wordmark 'Ovinek' set in Bricolage bold 24px at top left, columns 1 to 3, with the address in Public Sans 14px beside it in columns 4 to 7; the h1 'Kolo popravimo še danes, če je le mogoče' in rows 2 and 3 across columns 1 to 10, left aligned; below it in row 4 the lead in columns 1 to 6; in rows 4 and 5, columns 8 to 12, the signature line drawing: one thick emerald stroke (about 2vw wide, square ends) entering from the right page edge, running left, then bending through a rounded 90 degree turn and running down off the bottom of the section; the single action button 'Pokličite nas' sits in row 5, columns 1 to 3, a square-cornered emerald rectangle with onPrimary text. Section 2 (band, emerald field full width, 1 row): a ribbon of short words in onBand, Bricolage bold 2.5vw, left aligned and repeating across the width: 'cestna · gorska · treking · električna · vseh znamk · slovensko · english · italiano'. Section 3 (services 'Kaj delamo', white, 3 rows): heading in columns 1 to 5; a list in columns 7 to 12 with each item on its own row divided by a thin border rule: Osnovni servis, Veliki servis, Krpanje zračnice, and under them Izposoja: Gorsko kolo, Električno kolo; each rental item carries the line 'Čelada in ključavnica sta v ceni' in muted text. Section 4 (story, surface tint #eef5f2 full width, 3 rows): heading 'Kolesarite po dolini Soče' in columns 1 to 7, text in columns 1 to 6; in columns 8 to 12 a second instance of the bent emerald stroke, this time entering from the left of its column block and turning upward, as the river bend. Section 5 (steps 'Kako poteka popravilo', white, 4 rows): heading across columns 1 to 6, then three rows of plain text lines in columns 1 to 8, each row a short step without numerals, separated by border rules; the right columns stay empty. Section 6 (prices 'Cene izposoje in servisa', white, 2 rows): heading and the lead sentence in columns 1 to 6, a two-column table in columns 7 to 12 listing the offerings with the client's real prices, thin rules between rows. Section 7 (contact 'Obiščite nas', inverse near-black field full width, 4 rows): the phone as a large numeral in onInverse, 6vw, across columns 1 to 7; opening hours as a week strip in columns 1 to 7 below it; address, email and the one named person in columns 8 to 12 in Public Sans 16px; a simple schematic map of Padlih borcev in Tolmin, drawn in emerald lines on the dark field, in columns 8 to 12 below the address. Section 8 (call, emerald band, 2 rows): 'Imate okvaro ali iščete kolo za izlet?' at 4vw in onBand across columns 1 to 8, the short text in columns 1 to 6; no button here since the hero carries the one action, only the phone repeated as text.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. The only imagery is the bent stroke: a single thick emerald line with one rounded 90 degree turn, drawn by the layout system as a simple line ornament, used twice at large scale (hero on white, story section on the pale tint) and once small in the contact section's schematic map where the street bend is drawn in the same emerald. Type, the emerald band and the near-black contact field do the rest; no stamps, tags or trade props at all.","signature":"The thick emerald stroke that enters the hero from the page edge and bends a sharp rounded corner beside the headline: the bend of the road and the bend of the Soča as one mark, the shop's name made visible without a logo.","copy":{"headline":"Kolo popravimo še danes, če je le mogoče","lead":"Servisiramo cestna, gorska, treking in električna kolesa vseh znamk. Poleti hitre popravke naredimo isti dan. Govorimo tudi angleško in italijansko."},"imagePrompt":"A white first screen dominated by a bold left-aligned Bricolage Grotesque headline at about 9vw across ten columns, with a single thick emerald stroke entering from the right edge and bending down through a rounded corner beside it, a short lead paragraph and one square emerald button below; no photos, only type, the one bent line and white space."}
